verdicts.reason: Both share the same flaws. The 'EVENT MANAGMENT' eyebrow has dropped below the headline, flipping the reading order, and it is left-aligned while the headline is centred. The orange owl's top edge is sliced off flat, the confetti is almost gone, and the blue owl is shrunk to a tiny left-hugging afterthought with no balancing element. In A the blue owl is also jammed near the bottom edge under a big empty gap. B moves it up and closes that gap a little, but leaves dead space at the bottom, so it is only marginally better.
